# Dansk Kvalitetsdatabase for Inflammatoriske Tarmsygdomme

The **Dansk Kvalitetsdatabase for Inflammatoriske Tarmsygdomme** (DANIBD) is a national quality database in Denmark dedicated to monitoring, evaluating, and improving the treatment quality for patients with [[ibd|IBD]] (inflammatory bowel disease) [^src6]. Launched on October 1, 2022, under the [[regionernes-kliniske-kvalitetsudviklingsprogram|Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram]] (RKKP), DANIBD serves as the central infrastructure for standardized, registry-driven quality measurement across the Danish healthcare system [^src1]. The database is managed by the [[styregruppen-for-danibd|Styregruppen for DANIBD]] and its reports are published by [[sundhedsvaesenets-kvalitetsinstitut|Sundhedsvæsenets Kvalitetsinstitut]] and RKKP [^src2].

DANIBD identifies patients based on action diagnoses recorded in the [[landspatientregisteret|Landspatientregisteret]] (LPR). To be included, patients must have at least two hospital contacts with specific diagnoses, including [[crohns-sygdom|Crohn's disease]], [[colitis-ulcerosa|ulcerative colitis]], [[psc|primary sclerosing cholangitis]] (PSC), and [[korttarmssyndrom|short bowel syndrome]] [^src12]. The database's coverage is estimated to be over 90% [^src6]. In its first annual reporting period (October 1, 2022, to September 30, 2023), DANIBD tracked 32,641 adults and 740 children and young people with IBD [^src1]. By the second reporting period (October 1, 2023, to September 30, 2024), these numbers grew to 33,599 adults and 751 children and young people [^src2].

The database evaluates clinical practice through a set of national quality indicators. For instance, [[indikator-1a|Indikator 1a]] measures the proportion of newly diagnosed adults receiving relevant diagnostic workups, which reached 79% in the 2022–2023 period [^src9]. [[indikator-1b|Indikator 1b]] tracks complete workups for children, achieving 69% and missing the ≥80% development goal [^src10]. Other indicators monitor structured patient education for the newly diagnosed ([[indikator-2|Indikator 2]]) [^src12], postoperative colonoscopies after ileocecal resection for Crohn's disease ([[indikator-3|Indikator 3]]) [^src11], systematic fecal calprotectin monitoring during [[bmsl|biological and targeted synthetic drug]] (BMSL) therapy ([[indikator-4|Indikator 4]]) [^src5], 30-day re-operation rates ([[indikator-6|Indikator 6]]) [^src5], and preventive colonoscopies for patients with PSC ([[indikator-7|Indikator 7]]) [^src3]. 

Governance and clinical oversight are provided by a 17-member steering group comprising clinical experts from all five Danish regions, epidemiologists, data managers, and patient representatives like [[jannie-jensen|Jannie Jensen]] [^src7]. By aggregating data on surgical interventions, biomarker tracking, and regional performance, DANIBD provides critical benchmarking tools for hospital departments and regional health authorities to ensure equitable, evidence-based IBD care across Denmark [^src8].

## Claims

- Dansk Kvalitetsdatabase for Inflammatoriske Tarmsygdomme (DANIBD), der gik i drift d. 1. oktober 2022, præsenterer hermed den første årsrapport, der monitorerer behandlingskvaliteten for patienter med inflammatoriske tarmsygdomme (IBD) [^src1] (dansk-kvalitetsdatabase-for-inflammatoriske-tarmsygdomme, inflammatoriske-tarmsygdomme)

## Timeline

- 2022-10-01: Dansk Kvalitetsdatabase for Inflammatoriske Tarmsygdomme (DANIBD) gik i drift (dansk-kvalitetsdatabase-for-inflammatoriske-tarmsygdomme)
- 2023-09-30: Afslutning af opgørelsesperioden for den første DANIBD-årsrapport (dansk-kvalitetsdatabase-for-inflammatoriske-tarmsygdomme)
- 2024-04-16: Udgivelse af version Offentlig 1.1 af DANIBD-årsrapporten (dansk-kvalitetsdatabase-for-inflammatoriske-tarmsygdomme)
- 2022-10-01: DANIBD gik i drift (dansk-kvalitetsdatabase-for-inflammatoriske-tarmsygdomme)
- 2023-10-01: Start af rapporteringsperiode for DANIBD-årsrapport 2024 (dansk-kvalitetsdatabase-for-inflammatoriske-tarmsygdomme)
- 2024-09-30: Afslutning af rapporteringsperiode for DANIBD-årsrapport 2024 (dansk-kvalitetsdatabase-for-inflammatoriske-tarmsygdomme)
- 2022-10-01: Start af opgørelsesperioden for DANIBD-rapporten 2023 (dansk-kvalitetsdatabase-for-inflammatoriske-tarmsygdomme)
- 2023-09-30: Slut på opgørelsesperioden for DANIBD-rapporten 2023 (dansk-kvalitetsdatabase-for-inflammatoriske-tarmsygdomme)
- 1. oktober – 30. september: DANIBDs opgørelsesperiode (dansk-kvalitetsdatabase-for-inflammatoriske-tarmsygdomme)
- 2022-10-01: Start af opgørelsesperioden for DANIBD-kvalitetsdata i Appendiks 1–4 (dansk-kvalitetsdatabase-for-inflammatoriske-tarmsygdomme)
- 2023-09-30: Afslutning af opgørelsesperioden for DANIBD-kvalitetsdata i Appendiks 1–4 (dansk-kvalitetsdatabase-for-inflammatoriske-tarmsygdomme)
- 2022-10-01: Start af indberetningsperiode for Appendikstabellerne 5, 6 og 7 i DANIBD-rapporten 2023 (dansk-kvalitetsdatabase-for-inflammatoriske-tarmsygdomme)
- 2023-09-30: Slut på indberetningsperiode for Appendikstabellerne 5, 6 og 7 i DANIBD-rapporten 2023 (dansk-kvalitetsdatabase-for-inflammatoriske-tarmsygdomme)
- 2022-10-01: DANIBD blev lanceret (dansk-kvalitetsdatabase-for-inflammatoriske-tarmsygdomme)
- 2023-10-01: Start af årsrapportperioden 2023–2024 for DANIBD (dansk-kvalitetsdatabase-for-inflammatoriske-tarmsygdomme)
- 2024-09-30: Afslutning af årsrapportperioden 2023–2024 for DANIBD (dansk-kvalitetsdatabase-for-inflammatoriske-tarmsygdomme)
- 01.10.2022: Start af opgørelsesperioden for indikator 2 i DANIBD (indikator-2, dansk-kvalitetsdatabase-for-inflammatoriske-tarmsygdomme)
- 30.09.2023: Slut på opgørelsesperioden for indikator 2 i DANIBD (indikator-2, dansk-kvalitetsdatabase-for-inflammatoriske-tarmsygdomme)
